[보기] impress

It is very important to make a good __________ on others when we meet them for the first time.

det.ref: [원문] make a good impression on others [해석] 좋은 인상을 남기다. impress(v.) → impression(n.).
det.correct: make a + 명사 → impression. impressive(adj.)는 관사 a 뒤 부적절.
det.tip: 🔑 impress(v.) → impression(n.) → impressive(adj.). make an impression on = ~에게 인상을 남기다.

questions.passage: The main character, Winston Smith, does not agree with what the government is doing. He wants to fight against Big Brother, but he can't do it by himself. Will Winston find others to join him? Or will he give in and be controlled by Big Brother like the rest of the people?
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 주어진 단어를 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

[조건] 주어진 단어를 모두 사용 / 필요시 어형 변형 / 첫 글자 대문자
[보기] he / by / control / will / Big Brother

"그는 빅 브라더에 의해 통제를 받게 될 것이다."

→ _______________________________________

det.ref: [원문] be controlled by Big Brother [해석] 빅 브라더에 의해 통제를 받다. 미래 수동태: will + be + p.p.
det.correct: He + will + be controlled + by Big Brother. control → controlled(p.p.) 변형 필요.
det.tip: 🔑 미래 수동태: will be + p.p. control → controlled. give in = 굴복하다 ≈ surrender.

questions.wa: He will be controlled by Big Brother.

questions.passage: Peter Pan invites them to a fantastic island in the sky called Neverland. It is a magical place where dreams are born and excitement never ends. The children take Peter Pan's hand and their adventure begins.
questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 주어진 단어의 알맞은 형태를 쓰시오.

[보기] excite

It is a magical place where dreams are born and __________ never ends.

det.ref: [원문] excitement never ends [해석] 신나는 일이 끝나지 않는다. excite(v.) → excitement(n.).
det.correct: 주어 자리 → 명사 excitement. excited/exciting은 형용사로 부적절.
det.tip: 🔑 excite(v.) → excitement(n.) → excited(adj. 감정) → exciting(adj. 원인). -ment: 동사→명사 접미사.
